ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

2. When learning Project Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project Implementation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Implementation.

3. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

5. When learning Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship.

6. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

7. When learning Combinational Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Combinational Logic Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Combinational Logic Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Combinational Logic Circuits.

8. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Single-Phase alternating current Transformers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Solar Photovoltaic Installation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Lamps and Lamp Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Combinational Logic Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
